selection_rule: Preserve locked mean five-fold participant-weighted AP, exact ties use prespecified simplicity order: five saved baselines first, then listed tree candidates. Brier/log loss/calibration and ROC are mandatory tradeoff diagnostics, not an undisclosed new ranking objective.
probability_quality_policy: Require finite bounded probabilities and finite Brier/log loss. Quantify raw probability quality against the prevalence baseline. A newly selected tree must receive the locked reserved sigmoid calibration before any app-ready probability claim; apparent calibration-fit and threshold-selection scores are labeled, never used to re-rank. No clinical risk claim or category is established.
search_design: Two paired complexity settings per family, two training-only weight options, two profiles = 16 new candidates, five grouped folds = 80 fits; no random search or adaptive expansion, no validation-driven early stopping.
imbalance: No targeted resampling. RF balanced weights or XGB training-fold negative/positive scale_pos_weight. RF native bootstrap is training-only bagging, not class balancing. Evaluation rows unchanged.
